summary.summary: The team aligned on a user-friendly remote control design centered around accessibility, simplicity, and intuitive navigation, especially for older users. Animals drawn during the session reflected themes of independence, emotional connection, and intuition, which informed feature development. The product will feature a minimalist layout, large print options, and a flip-top design for screen expansion, all while using affordable plastic construction instead of metal. Key decisions include a €25/£17 retail price, 50% profit margin, and a focus on broad, non-technical users.
summary.title: Remote Control Design & Accessibility Focus
